import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 1000100;
    static final double PI = 3.141592653589;
    static final double EPS = 1e-20;
    static final int BS = 10;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int ZERO = 10001;
    static final int YJSNPI = 8101919;
    static final int INF = 1 << 28;

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Mat extends ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> {
        Mat(int a, int b) {
            for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
                ArrayList<Long> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(b, 0L));
                this.add(row);
            }
        }
    }

    static long N;
    static int K;
    static Mat[] R = new Mat[40];
    static Mat[][][] D = new Mat[100][40][];
    
    static void mat_init(Mat A, int a, int b) {
        A.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
            ArrayList<Long> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(b, 0L));
            A.add(row);
        }
    }

    static Mat mul(Mat A, Mat B) {
        int aSize = A.size();
        int bSize = B.get(0).size();
        Mat C = new Mat(aSize, bSize);
        for (int i = 0; i < aSize; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < B.size(); k++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < bSize; j++) {
                    long val = C.get(i).get(j) + A.get(i).get(k) * B.get(k).get(j);
                    C.get(i).set(j, val);
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static void show_mat(Mat A) {
        for (int i = 0; i < A.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < A.get(0).size(); j++) {
                System.out.print(A.get(i).get(j) + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        System.out.println();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int cnt = 0;
        long nN = 1;
        while (nN <= N) {
            nN *= K;
            cnt++;
        }
        nN /= K;

        int[] d = new int[cnt];
        long tempN = N;
        long tempN2 = nN;
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
            d[i] = (int)(tempN / tempN2);
            tempN %= tempN2;
            tempN2 /= K;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            R[i] = new Mat(0,0);
            mat_init(R[i], K + 1, K + 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= cnt; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                D[i][j] = new Mat(0,0);
                mat_init(D[i][j], K + 1, K + 1);
            }
        }

        // Initialize R[0] and R[1]
        R[0] = new Mat(K + 1, K + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            R[0].get(i).set(i, 1L);
        }
        R[1] = new Mat(K + 1, K + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            R[1].get(i).set(i, 1L);
        }
        R[0].get(K).set(K, 1L);
        R[1].get(K).set(K, 1L);

        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            R[0].get(j).set(j, 1L);
            R[1].get((j + K - 1) % K).set(j, 1L);
        }

        for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
            R[j] = mul(R[j - 1], R[1]);
        }

        // Initialize D[0][0]
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
            D[0][0] = new Mat(0,0);
            mat_init(D[0][0], K + 1, K + 1);
            D[0][0].get(j).set(j, 1L);
            D[0][0].get(j).set(0, 1L);
        }

        int maxI = cnt;
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxI; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                D[i][j] = new Mat(0,0);
                mat_init(D[i][j], K + 1, K + 1);
                D[i][j] = mul(D[i][j - 1], mul(mul(R[K - j], D[i][0]), R[j]));
            }
            if (i + 1 <= maxI) {
                D[i + 1][0] = D[i][K - 1];
            }
        }

        Mat ans = new Mat(1, K + 1);
        ans.get(0).set(K, 1L);
        int md = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
            if (d[i] != 0) {
                Mat temp1 = mul(R[K - md], D[cnt - i - 1][d[i] - 1]);
                Mat temp2 = mul(temp1, R[md]);
                ans = mul(ans, temp2);
            }
            md += d[i];
            md %= K;
        }

        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            res += ans.get(0).get(i);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
